title: Pure additive convergence
current: Net-new tables, indexes and additive columns need no governed migration. Boot's creation phase applies them on every server boot, before the ordered history. A deploy driver connected straight to its database (a *-db-admin connection or a local universe) applies the same phase before its run's first in-process call, so a release never meets a column only its own boot would add. A busy table refuses as release_start_schema_lock_unavailable after the short run-lock timeout, and nothing about the run starts. An HTTPS driver converges nothing: the serving build answers every call.
